evidence.observation: Pressure 3.018 Torr at start of growth, matching the ~3.0 Torr plateau during the ramp.
Pressure has risen every reading to 3.509 Torr (+16%) over 720 s.
Argon flow steady at ~100 sccm, so more gas going in does not explain the rise.
Temperature held at 750 °C, heater power steady at ~45%, so thermal control looks normal.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so the growth atmosphere cannot be checked and an air leak cannot be told apart from an exhaust restriction.

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 reading or a leak check would tell the two apart: O2 rising points to a seal leak, O2 staying flat points to exhaust blockage. Other useful checks: a rate-of-rise test with the argon off and the exhaust valve shut, or checking the pump/exhaust line for a restriction.
